sloka: स तस्मिन्नचले तिष्ठन्वनान्युपवनानि च ।स नगाग्रे च तां लङ्कां ददर्श पवनात्मजः ॥५-२-८॥
transliteration: sa tasminnacale tiṣṭhanvanānyupavanāni ca ।sa nagāgre ca tāṁ laṅkāṁ dadarśa pavanātmajaḥ ॥5-2-8॥

translations.english: That son of the Windgod stood on the mountain and saw the forests and groves round Lanka situated on the mountain peak.
